title: chrysothamnus nauseosus subsp. albicaulis
intro: Chrysothamnus nauseosus subsp. albicaulis, commonly known as Rubescens or Gray Rabbitbrush, is a shrub-like plant native to North America. It is used in herbal medicine due to its reported health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Rubescens include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which help in wound healing and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
